title: Add negative coverage for synchronous federation binding durability readback
outcome: Exercise the legacy None-lease synchronous fallback with bound sessions and a stopped persistence channel, proving exact persisted binding/native-token readback can pass and refuse independently of metadata durability.
acceptance: A focused regression demonstrates successful exact-row synchronous readback and a negative stored-row/binding/native-token mismatch without weakening persistence semantics.
The full federation tests remain green; the test does not synthesize a successful durability acknowledgement.
